chapter: Los Angeles scene and the Ellington sound
title: Kay Davis's years with the band
summary: She stayed three or four years and contributed a distinct sound as an instrumental voice.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them

blocks.x: How long was Kay Davis with the band?

Oh, she must have been there four -- three or four years. Four years or more. She had a very beautiful quality of rendering -- a very beautiful way of rendering a number, and she became another -- well, what do you call it, like when I joined the band they were saying that I brought a certain tonal effect in. Well, she did too.
She brought her -- yeah. Yeah, she was great.
I remember when I saw the band and she was there.
But she mostly sang the obbligato, right?
There was one called 'Minnehaha,' and -- well, any numbers that would --
